Left-joins all Montgomery tracts to pre-aggregated pharmacy counts and returns tracts with zero listed pharmacies, ordered by count then tract name.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_11fb7d'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(pc.n, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
WHERE COALESCE(pc.n, 0) = 0
ORDER BY pharmacy_count ASC, t.name ASC
